scope: Continuation of the approved finite supervised graft probe; no neural or teacher algorithm change.
draft_revision_before_freeze: The initial draft used seeds3..19. Independent review identified short unit probes at3,4,5 (not the declared80+80 run), so the final namespace is offset by1000000 before any confirmation execution to avoid that overlap. No outcome-based seed selection was performed.

primary_metric.name: normalized_recovery_auc_difference
primary_metric.definition: Trapezoidal current-MSE integral over recovery updates0..80, divided by80; fixed-support minus adaptive, paired within seed.
primary_metric.direction: positive favors adaptive recovery on this fixed synthetic teacher fixture

secondary_metrics: last10 recovery-update mean MSE difference, fixed minus adaptive
final-update MSE difference, fixed minus adaptive
isolated error change immediately across structural events
old-target error as a descriptive same-input relabeling tradeoff

analysis.uncertainty: 95 percent percentile bootstrap for mean paired AUC difference, resampling independent confirmation seeds only; conditional on this one fixed teacher fixture

descriptive_rl_run.inference: descriptive only; one independent training seed; distance/action changes are not success or general usefulness

preservation: Do not pause, restart or send controls to process4272/port8770 or write its live checkpoint.
limitations: The confirmation varies initialization, minibatches and support randomness within the same hand-declared teacher/candidate graph.
It does not establish RL task advantage, biological fidelity, retention, robustness on other shifts, or superiority over other growth policies.
The teacher switch reassigns different targets to the same inputs, so old/new target errors express a necessary tradeoff, not a general catastrophic-forgetting test.
